newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - U.S. Office estimates.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - U.S. Office estimates.

text.p: -- Robertson Stephens & Co said analyst Susan Lacerra raised her 1997 earnings estimate for U.S. Office Products to $1.20 a share from $1.08, and raised her 1998 estimate to $1.50 from $1.42.
-- Lacerra cited the company's high visibility on acquisition backlog and strong internal sales growth, among other things.
-- She said that by acquiring Systems House, U.S. Office Products had "dramatically boosted" its management information systems capability.
